_doc: The first slice of the economy mod (#524): the Town Center is the storehouse, the lumber and mining camps are the woodcutter's hut and the quarry, and the sawmill is new. Buildings cost planks and stone, carried to the site. Everything for war and the late game goes.

town_center.name: Storehouse
town_center.desc: Holds the town's goods; workers carry them in and out. Trains workers.

lumber_camp.name: Woodcutter's Hut
lumber_camp.desc: Woodcutters drop logs here; carriers take them where they're needed.

mining_camp.name: Quarry
mining_camp.desc: Stone is dropped here; carriers take it where it's needed.

sawmill.name: Sawmill
sawmill.desc: Saws one log into two planks.

inn.name: Inn
inn.desc: Feeds the town: hungry workers eat here when their home has no food. One food makes three meals, so it feeds more for less than homes do. Carriers keep it stocked.

house.desc: A home: two beds and a small larder. While a bed is free and the larder has food, a child is born now and then.
